links.comparator_used: Original baseline prompts without the targeted safety-oriented prompt added (same questions, n = 7)
links.outcome: Accuracy, completeness, practicality, readability and safety scores (linear mixed models, Hedges' g as effect size)
links.effect: Deepseek-V2.5 improved significantly on all five dimensions (p < 0.001), with the largest gains in safety and completeness. GPT-4o improved significantly on four dimensions but not safety (p = 0.227). Model × condition interaction was significant only for safety (p = 0.002).
links.quote: Targeted prompt engineering produced significant improvements for Deepseek-V2.5 across all five evaluation dimensions (p < 0.001), with the largest gains in safety and completeness.
